comparison.objective: Remove a cake dome and serve a slice onto a plate; candidate tunes and locks a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Cover removal and delicate food transfer versus recessed tool engagement, bimanual stabilization, fine adjustment, and torque-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Cake must be uncovered and transferred to the dessert plate; candidate requires two non-bottoming stops and retained collar setting. No detailed serving rubric/spec is available.
comparison.reason: Food serving does not exercise adjustment, force-controlled locking, or evaluation of dynamic mechanical response.
